verdict.rationale: Swell is a commerce platform, so an in-person point-of-sale sharing catalog, inventory and customers with the online store is a fair question. The evidence pack never mentions a POS or in-person selling. The single-catalog claim (swell-docs-30) covers wholesale and retail operations, not an in-store POS, so it is adjacent and earns no credit.

support.subject: As a merchant, I can sell in person with a point-of-sale that shares the same catalog, inventory, and customers as my online store
